notes: §1985:XIII.3.9.3 SR11: Table 1 lists the only clause combinations of a format 3 entry; 'A blank indicates that the clause is not permitted', PICTURE is M in all five rows, and the rows are PIC+SUM, PIC+COLUMN+SUM(+BWZ,USAGE), PIC+SOURCE(+COLUMN,JUST,GI,USAGE), PIC+SOURCE(+COLUMN,BWZ,GI,USAGE), PIC+COLUMN+VALUE(+JUST,GI,USAGE), each with SIGN and LINE permitted. ReportEntryClauseTable#Permits holds the five rows verbatim and ReportSectionBinder#ScreenReportEntryClauseTable asks it of every elementary entry when DialectLevel < 2002 (COBOL2247), after #ScreenReportEntryClausePresence refuses two of SOURCE/SUM/VALUE (#AlternativesWritten) and #ScreenReportEntryFormats takes the SR8a USAGE case. Probes at --std 85: row 1 (unprinted SC PIC S999 SUM SIGN LEADING SEPARATE, sourced as '- 12'), row 2 (SUM + BWZ + USAGE), row 3 (SOURCE JUST RIGHT '   HELLO'; SOURCE + GROUP INDICATE with no COLUMN accepted), row 4 (SOURCE + BWZ + GI + USAGE, '-12 HELLO' then blank), row 5 (VALUE JUST RIGHT) accepted; SUM+JUST, VALUE+BWZ, unprinted SUM+BWZ, SOURCE+JUST+BWZ, SUM+GI refused COBOL2247, unprinted SUM+USAGE refused (SR8a), SOURCE with no PICTURE refused. The witness (a report heading entry PIC X(5) VALUE "HELLO" with no COLUMN, the blank COLUMN cell of row 5) is refused COBOL2247 at its line.

next.reason: 1985 Table 1 makes PICTURE mandatory in every format 3 row and permits JUSTIFIED, BLANK WHEN ZERO and GROUP INDICATE with SOURCE while COLUMN is optional; USAGE is not permitted on an unprintable SUM entry. 2023: 'The PICTURE clause may be omitted ... when an alphanumeric, boolean or national literal ... is specified in the VALUE clause' (§2023:13.15.3 SR14) - looser; 'If BLANK WHEN ZERO or JUSTIFIED is specified, a COLUMN clause shall also be specified' (§2023:13.15.3 SR15) and GROUP INDICATE needs 'a COLUMN clause and a SOURCE or VALUE clause' (§2023:13.18.28.3 SR1) - stricter; USAGE is offered in every entry (§2023:13.15.2). Kept: PICTURE with SOURCE or SUM (§2023:13.15.3 SR12), COLUMN with VALUE (SR13), COLUMN needs SOURCE, VALUE or SUM (SR10), these clauses only in elementary entries (SR11). All compile-time.
